historySource.indexText: Proclaimed Mount Olympus National Monument March 2, 1909; transferred from U.S. Forest Service Aug. 10, 1933; renamed and redesignated national park June 29, 1938. Boundary changes: Jan. 2, 1940; May 29, 1943; Jan. 6, 1953; Oct. 21, 1976; Oct. 10, 1986; Nov. 16, 1988; Sept. 30, 1992; Dec. 22, 2010; Feb. 27, 2012. Wilderness designated Nov. 16, 1988. Designated a Biosphere Reserve 1976. Designated a World Heritage Site Oct. 27, 1981.
